mentions.name: Love2D drum machine
mentions.description: A small drum machine built with the Love2D framework, planned to use pure data patches generated by the author's Clojure/Fennel DSL so that internal patches can be live-updated.
mentions.source_excerpt: looking to make a small drum machine in love2d and being able to live update the internal patches would be fun
